scripts.type-check: yarn --cwd frontend type-check && yarn --cwd backend type-check
scripts.lint: yarn --cwd frontend lint && yarn --cwd backend lint
scripts.lint:strict: yarn --cwd frontend lint:strict && yarn --cwd backend lint:strict
scripts.format: yarn --cwd frontend format && yarn --cwd backend format
scripts.format:check: yarn --cwd frontend format:check && yarn --cwd backend format:check
scripts.test: yarn --cwd frontend test && yarn --cwd backend test
scripts.verify: yarn type-check && yarn lint:strict && yarn format:check && yarn test
